info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Vulture Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API allows for the creation of detailed catalogs for the Vulture Recliner product line. It enables businesses to manage and update the specifications, features, and options available for this particular recliner model. Developers can utilize this API to support e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems where accurate product details are essential. Typical users include product managers and e-commerce developers who aim to enhance user experiences by providing comprehensive product information.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create detailed information for the Vulture Recliner. Ensure that all necessary fields are appropriately filled out to successfully create the details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the Vulture Recliner operation. It should contain all relevant information that is required for processing the request and ensure successful execution of the operation.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the details of the recliner.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of a single vulture recliner.
